cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When Summoning symbols land, their size can be 1x2, 1x3 or 1x4. When Summoning symbols land, they all reveal a different stack of the same paying or Wild symbol. The symbol size determines the number of stacked symbols on each Summoning symbol.

 Summoning symbol size 1x2 reveals 3, 4, 5 or 6 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x3 reveals 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x4 reveals 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 or 12 symbol stacks.

 If a Wild symbol lands directly above or directly below a Summoning symbol on the same reel, the Summoning symbol will increase in size by expanding to cover that Wild symbol once the grid is settled.

 When Summoning symbols are part of a win, they will stay on the grid as other winning symbols cascade out. The winning Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol. If subsequent wins occur, the Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol; this continues until no new wins occur. 

 When there are no more wins, all symbols, including the Summoning symbols, are removed from the grid for the next spin. Summoning symbols can land on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS – TORTURED
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the TWISTED bonus. In addition, 2 Summoning symbols are guaranteed on the first spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins

 3+ FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
